name: Christmas
overview: Scripture reveals the birth of Jesus Christ as a divine fulfillment of prophecy, highlighting His identity as Immanuel, God with us, born of a virgin (Isaiah 7:14; Matthew 1:18). This event brings great joy and gladness, as many rejoice in the arrival of the promised Savior, who is called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, and Prince of Peace (Isaiah 9:6; Luke 1:14). The coming of the King, humble and bringing salvation, is a cause for rejoicing among God's people (Zechariah 9:9). Celebrations involving feasting, joy, and the giving of gifts are biblically rooted practices reflecting the joy of deliverance and salvation (Esther 9:22).
